moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view looking down on scrubland: a curving road lined with bright rectangular shapes, buildings above it. The sensor drifts slowly.
A very faint small light spot crosses diagonally from near the top left corner toward the bottom right, fading out after about 4.5 s.
The sensor pans, then the view cuts to a ring-shaped site dotted with bright points under pale haze.
After a dark frame, a closer view of two large bright rectangular buildings on open ground.
The wide view of the curving road and its bright rectangles returns.
A pale patch of haze drifts in from the left, spreads across the frame and fades.
The view stays on the road and buildings to the end, slowly turning so the road curves up the right side.

notes: 4:3 picture with side bars (crop applied). The transit at 0:59 is only a few pixels and barely brighter than the ground; frame-difference needed to see it clearly.
